status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Brooks is expected to undergo surgery Wednesday to repair a core-muscle injury and is likely to miss at least six weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
status.longComment: Brooks is expected to be officially placed on injured reserve in the coming days after he exited this past Sunday's 34-3 win over the Falcons due to what had previously been labeled as a groin injury. With Brooks set to miss time, Chuba Hubbard should be further insulated as the Panthers' No. 1 back, while AJ Dillon is lone healthy backup option on the 53-man roster. Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston relays that the Panthers plan to work out veteran Austin Ekeler on Wednesday, and he could eventually be signed to provide further depth in the backfield.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Coker (ankle) was limited in Wednesday's practice, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
status.longComment: An ankle injury slowed Coker in practice last week as well, but he was able to play through it and register eight grabs in the win over the Falcons. He was limited Wednesday, and this could be the norm for Coker during the week until he's back to 100 percent. At this stage, his availability for Sunday's game against the Browns does not appear to be in question.

status.label: Questionable
status.longComment: Phillips was forced to sit out the team's first practice of the week as he nurses a back injury. The 27-year-old likely suffered the injury during the team's 34-3 win over Atlanta in Week 2, a game during which he registered two total tackles (one solo), including 1.0 sacks. Phillips will have two more opportunities to practice before the Panthers travel to face Cleveland in Week 3.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Lloyd (calf) did not participate at the Panthers' practice Wednesday.
status.longComment: Lloyd popped up on the injury report with a calf issue to open the week. The injury occurred during the first half of Sunday's 34-3 win over Atlanta, but the linebacker is not too concerned about it, per Joe Person of The Athletic. Lloyd will have two more chances to return to practice before the team travels to face the Browns in Week 3.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Cherelus (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Falcons, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
status.longComment: Cherelus exited in the second quarter of Sunday's game after sustaining a shoulder injury without having recorded any stats. If Cherelus does not return, Isaiah Simmons could see more rotational usage for the Panthers' defense.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Scott (ribs) did not participate at the Panthers' practice Wednesday.
status.longComment: Scott suffered an abdominal injury in the team's 34-3 win over the Falcons on Sunday, and it is now understood to be an injury to his ribs. The 31-year-old will have two more chances to return to practice prior to traveling to face Cleveland in Week 3.
